The design of the Jack Razor became one of the first modern safety razors and influenced many later designs.

The first safety razor was invented by William Earles Wilson in 1895. Wilson's design consisted of a blade mounted in a rectangular frame with a handle. This design significantly reduced the risk of cuts and became popular because it was easier to use and safer than the older straight razor designs. Wilson patented his invention in 1895, and it became one of the first widely used safety razors.
